observed_text:
For an investigation handoff, the preparation guidance supported by the returned cards is: keep used lubricant samples from bearings, housing and seal areas separately packaged and properly labelled, and secure a separate sample of new, unused lubricant [EV-K01-006]. Record any specification or batch information available from the new lubricant's container; this is an inclusive OR, so capture whichever category is present and both if both exist, without fabricating missing identity [EV-K01-006]. Obtain the technical specifications and any related material safety documentation to accompany lubricant shipments [EV-K01-006]. Preserve evidence order: before cleaning, record initial appearance and residual lubricant amount/condition, and sample the lubricant before cleaning [EV-K01-009]. This ordering card does not authorize the page's solvents or cleaning actions for an unknown machine [EV-K01-009]. The scenario's assumed cause of poor-lubrication spherical roller smearing is an independently specified teaching assumption, not an observation; NSK's Smearing 7 example concerns convex rollers of the spherical roller bearing in Smearing 5 and attributes that example to poor lubrication, but it does not establish a sample root cause [EV-I01-002]. No required sample quantity can be chosen from the returned evidence: no sampling quantity, container model, product selection or laboratory acceptance threshold is supplied [EV-K01-006]. Information actually supplied here does not include actual device records, lubricant container identity/specification/batch, sampling quantity, model-specific thresholds, or aviation/reuse authorization, so none of these should be inferred [EV-K01-006].

Evidence limitations:
No sample quantity, container model, product selection or laboratory acceptance threshold is supplied in the cited preparation steps, so a required sample quantity cannot be chosen [EV-K01-006].
Specification and batch are an inclusive OR, not an unconditional dual requirement; missing lubricant identity or documents must not be fabricated [EV-K01-006].
The cleaning-order card registers evidence-preservation order only and does not authorize solvents or cleaning actions for an unknown machine [EV-K01-009].
The NSK smearing example is a manufacturer's case statement for a spherical roller bearing, not a project observation or sample root cause, and does not establish a specific lubricant, dose or acceptance limit [EV-I01-002].
Scope is registered generic bearing education only; no model-specific, CWRU-transfer, aviation or reuse authorization is provided [EV-K01-006].
The scenario's poor-lubrication smearing cause is an independently specified teaching assumption, not an observation or classifier inference [EV-I01-002].

EV-I01-002
